channel.title: Burundi - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Burundi, every source cited.

item.title: Burundi soldier shoots man smuggling fuel
item.description: A man is in critical condition after being shot by a soldier while transporting fuel from the DRC.

item.title: PAM equips Burundi institutions with 74 devices
item.description: Computers, printers, and scanners will strengthen public services for school feeding and social protection.

item.title: Burundi U15 team finishes top 8 in division
item.description: The Burundi U15 team reached the quarter-finals of Division D at the FIFA U15 World Cup Festival in Baku.
